# GenerationalAITransition

## Definition
The concept of moving from one AI paradigm (e.g., statistical learning) to a fundamentally different one (e.g., contextual reasoning) as a strategic milestone. Defines the performance and capability targets that in-network neuromorphic computing must meet to enable next-generation autonomous systems.
